CustomField.description: Number of attachment files retained (kept) for this email after InboundEmailAttachmentService.classify() applies the MIME/extension allow-list, the image size floor, and the MAX_ATTACHMENTS cap. Files dropped during classification are not counted here — see Dropped_Attachment_Notes__c for what was excluded and why.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by the attachment capture pipeline. Compare against Dropped_Attachment_Notes__c to see what was excluded.
CustomField.label: Attachment Count
